We encourage testing a large range of inputs before writing a description.

[DESCRIPTION]: Describe what the function is doing in language. 
[CODE]: Write python code that approximates the behavior of the function.

[DESCRIPTION]: The function takes a string `s` and returns `s.capitalize()` — it title-cases the first character (uppercasing, with special unicode title-casing) and lowercases all remaining characters. Digits and symbols in the first position are left unchanged while the rest is still lowercased.

[CODE]:
```python
def f(s):
    return s.capitalize()
```
